question: Should OpenClaw permanently support `openclaw auth list` as a second public command path when `openclaw models auth list` is already shipped and documented?
rationale: Adding the alias also creates core/plugin root-precedence policy, so source correctness alone cannot determine whether the compatibility burden is intended product direction.

options.title: Keep one canonical path
options.body: Do not add the shortcut and continue directing users and scripts to `openclaw models auth list`.

options.title: Sponsor a generic alias
options.body: Approve the shortcut only with a reusable ownership contract, conditional documentation, and live core/plugin collision proof.

recommendation.title: Keep one canonical path
recommendation.body: Do not add the shortcut and continue directing users and scripts to `openclaw models auth list`.

likelyOwner.reason: The shipped canonical auth-list behavior is credited to this owner, making them the best available routing candidate for whether it should gain another public command path.
